narr: A push of monsoonal moisture resulted in sporadic flash flooding and isolated microbursts for the end of the month of July.
ev: Rangers at Zion National Park reported flash flooding in Pine Creek and side canyons off of Bridge Mountain due to excessive rainfall in the region.

Heavy rain in portions of the headwaters region of the Paria River resulted in a flow downstream. The Paria River Near Kanab, Utah gauge indicated a rise from 5 CFS to over 520 CFS in a span of 10 minutes, and peaked at 842 CFS, with a rise of over 2 feet.

Thunderstorms produced heavy rainfall over the high terrain near the town of Hildale over the course of an hour, with Multi-Radar/Multi-Sensor 1-hour estimates of around 1 to 1.5 inches of rainfall. Light to moderate rain persisted for 2 to 3 hours thereafter. The rainfall resulted in a strong flow in Short Creek through Hildale and on into Colorado City. Dispatch from Colorado City reported all street crossings across the creek were closed due to flooding, and 3 feet of fast moving water was reported to be flowing across Hildale Street.
lsr: ZION NATIONAL PARK RANGERS REPORTED FLASH FLOODING IN PINE CREEK AND SIDE CANYONS OFF OF BRIDGE MOUNTAIN.
PARIA RIVER GAUGE AT US-89 NEAR KANAB ROSE FROM 5 CFS TO TO OVER 520 CFS IN JUST 10 MINUTES, AND PEAKED AT 842 CFS, A RISE OF OVER 2 FEET.
COLORADO CITY DISPATCH REPORTS ALL STREET CROSSINGS ACROSS THE CREEK ARE CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING. THREE FEET OF FAST MOVING WATER WAS REPORTED FLOWING ACROSS HILDALE STREET.
